# Pass 42 — the theoretical_limit retirement (generated by tools/audit-limits.mjs; do not edit by hand)

Revision a16833fcc7f7 · 41 prose rows on 41 pathways · classes: generic-bound-missing 6 · already-typed 30 · not-a-bound 5 · actions: typed 6 · removed 32 · noted 3. No pathway carries a theoretical_limit; the performance object is strict.

Policy (from the dispositions file):
- **theoretical_limit** — a limit lives in the typed constraint graph or nowhere: a constraint entity keeps the canonical formula, metric, applicability filters and required basis; a bounded_by claim on a phenomenon attaches it generically with evidence; a Pathway.bounds[] entry attaches an upper-bound or formula-bound constraint to one exact architecture with evidence and is refused when the bound is already reachable from the route; the thermodynamic-bound check merges both through one applicability / metric / basis machinery; after the sweep the field is unwritable (strict performance object) and the route page lists the typed bounds instead of prose
